baseline.scope: Selected public declarations in agent-framework/dotnet/src and this Go SDK. Source identities and API correspondences were inspected at the pinned revisions; behavioral equivalence was not re-audited. A type mapping covers only that type, not all its members. Overloads are separate member entries. External dependency declarations, including Microsoft.Extensions.AI content/tool types, and unlisted APIs have not been inventoried. The historical feature inventory remains in Git history, not as a second source of symbol mappings.
